info.title: GATEWAY-batchinsertion-List Telecom Sim Status-v5-spec
info.description: The Telecom SIM Status Retrieval API enables users to access the current status of telecom SIM cards in batch. Designed for telecom providers and developers, this API provides critical insights on the operational state of SIM cards, allowing for efficient monitoring and management. Typical use cases include inventory management, troubleshooting, and customer service enhancements. By retrieving comprehensive status information, users can make informed decisions to optimize their telecom operations.

get.summary: Retrieve the current status of the SIM.
get.description: This endpoint allows you to fetch the current operational status of the SIM. It provides information on whether the SIM is active, inactive, or facing any issues.

requestBody.description: This request retrieves the current operational status of the SIM. The body should include any necessary parameters to specify the desired SIM details.

200.description: Request completed successfully, returning the current status.

ListTelecomSimStatusRequest.description: Represents the request body for the GET operation under the _s_sim_s_status_ operations. This schema is expected to be a JSON string.
